_comment: The committed HMAC test vector. Both magmux's Go test and any client that
signs a command must reproduce `sig` exactly from these fields.
The canonical string is the eight fields below joined with \n, in this
order, with `args` LAST: it is the only field whose content is
attacker-chosen and unbounded, so a newline inside it cannot shift a later
field into a different position. `args` is signed as the RAW JSON STRING
that is stored in the database, not as a re-encoding of the parsed value —
two spellings of the same object have two different signatures, and the
one that counts is the one on the wire.
sig = lowercase hex of HMAC-SHA256(key, canonical).
canonical:
magmux.cmd.v1
test-host
magmux-1780000000
owner-uid-1
1780000000000
abcdefghijklmnop0123
list
{"all":true}
